content.text: Digital creators in countries like Nigeria and Ghana face significant hurdles when trying to sell courses online, especially with platforms like Teachable and Stripe. These services are often unavailable or impose strict limitations that can disrupt business operations. This post evaluates the options available for creators looking to circumvent these restrictions and provides a robust alternative that ensures full control over their digital sales infrastructure.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable is a popular platform that enables creators to sell courses with ease, offering tools for course creation, marketing, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-what-actually-how-3|Payment Infrastructure]]-methods-filipino-digital-creators-one-afternoon-fast-2|payment]] processing. However, it also requires users to rely on Stripe or PayPal, limiting accessibility in many regions. Stripe operates in only 46 countries, leaving a vast number of creators without access. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a comprehensive solution that enables creators to build their own online store without dependence on external payment processors. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, creators can establish a fully operational storefront that is not restricted by geographical limitations.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like PayPal and Stripe are notorious for their geographical restrictions, resulting in significant barriers for creators in countries like Nigeria, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. For instance, a PayPal account suspension can lead to funds being held for up to 180 days without recourse. This kind of uncertainty makes it difficult for creators to manage their income and maintain cash flow. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure is explicitly designed for these creators. By employing non-restrictive payment solutions like NOWPayments, which operates with over 300 cryptocurrencies and requires no KYC, creators can process transactions without the fear of sudden account limitations or access issues.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal can take days to process transactions, especially in regions with banking restrictions. Furthermore, Stripe charges fees that can accumulate quickly, particularly in countries with lower average transaction values. In stark contrast, using NOWPayments offers a minimal 0.5% fee with instant payment confirmation through on-chain processing. For creators, this means a faster, more cost-effective way to monetize their products and receive funds without the burdensome waiting period associated with conventional platforms.
Sovereign infrastructure guarantees ownership and control over your digital sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With platforms like Teachable or Gumroad, creators often find themselves locked into ecosystems where they do not fully control their data or customer relationships. Ownership is a critical issue, as these platforms can change terms or restrict access at any time. Conversely, sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators with full ownership over their sales data, customer interactions, and product delivery processes. With tools like Cloudflare Pages and Google Drive for file storage, creators can automate delivery and ensure their products are always accessible to customers without reliance on third-party services.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in restricted countries, the choice between conventional platforms and sovereign commerce infrastructure is clear. If you find yourself locked out by services like Stripe or PayPal, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides an excellent alternative. Deployed in just 48 hours, it combines the power of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, allowing for scalable digital sales with full control. This architecture not only circumvents geographical restrictions but also ensures that creators maintain their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-what-nobody-tells-27|COREMERCH guide to financial]] sovereignty.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Instant crypto payments mean you never have to wait for funds again.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.

Using PayPal in Nigeria can be problematic due to account restrictions and potential suspensions. Many creators find themselves unable to access funds, making alternative solutions like NOWPayments a more reliable choice.
What happens if my PayPal account gets suspended?

If your PayPal account is suspended, your funds can be held for up to 180 days without the option to appeal. This creates a cash flow issue for creators, highlighting the need for more dependable payment solutions.
How do I handle taxes when selling digital products?

Handling taxes when selling digital products involves understanding your local tax laws and potentially collecting sales tax from customers. Keep detailed records of your transactions to ensure compliance with tax regulations.
